notes: AEAT Manual practico IVA 2024, ANEXO 'Modelo 303 de autoliquidacion del Impuesto sobre el Valor Anadido' (published asset Cap_9_303_es_es.pdf): the official form filled with AEAT own worked-example figures for the supuesto practico del senor X (cuarto trimestre). Authored and rendered by AEAT publication toolchain (Adobe InDesign / PDF/X-4), not by the sede declaracion generator and not by this project fixture generator, and carrying no taxpayer identity at all - no NIF, no CSV, no presentador. It is therefore neither a sanitised real filing (real_corpus) nor generator output (synthetic_generated), and is declared aeat_published_facsimile. Its worth is the printed per-casilla figures, an independent AEAT authority for grading the engine; it cannot anchor the justificante parser, because parsing it as a declaracion fails at the NIF step by construction. The bundled Manual_IVA_2024.pdf does NOT contain these annex pages - they are a separate published asset of the manual HTML edition - so this is evidence the repository did not otherwise hold. These specimens exposed a defect the generated corpus cannot express: _generate.py prints an explicit 0,00 into every box and prints no box numbers, so a BLANK box - whose line ends on its own printed box number - is unreachable from the synthetic corpus by construction. A fully green fixture suite could never have found it.
